days.fullScript: Hi busy moms! Are you struggling to find time for a workout? I've got you covered! In this reel, I'll be sharing my top 3 quick and effective exercises that you can do in just 10 minutes a day. From squats to lunges, these exercises will help you get fit and feel amazing. Trust me, I've been there too! As a busy mom myself, I know how hard it can be to prioritize your own health and fitness. But with these simple exercises, you can get started today and see real results. So, who's ready to get fit and feel amazing? #fitnessmotivation #busymoms #quickworkouts
days.bRollSuggestions: Footage of busy moms exercising, playing with their kids, and enjoying healthy meals
days.cameraAngles: Close-up shots of the exercises, wide shots of the busy mom working out
days.shotList: Introduction, exercise demonstrations, testimonials from satisfied clients
days.editingInstructions: Add upbeat background music, use transitions to make the reel engaging
days.musicSuggestions: Upbeat and energetic music, such as 'Can't Stop' by Red Hot Chili Peppers
